content: Kodi puts the add-on's own root directory on sys.path when it invokes entrypoint.py or service.py, so a package tree rooted at the add-on root (resources/lib/...) imports with no sys.path manipulation, provided every directory has __init__.py. Each script invocation runs in its own CPython sub-interpreter (CPythonInvoker) inside the single Kodi process, so sys.modules is per-invocation and top-level package names do not collide across add-ons. Kodi 20 regressed sys.path ordering to put system site-packages BEFORE the add-on dir and its script.module dependencies (xbmc/xbmc#22985), so a system-installed requests/urllib3 could shadow the bundled one; fixed by PR #23244. Vendoring under the add-on's own resources/lib avoids the class of problem entirely because those modules are reached by a package path the system cannot shadow.
